responsibility: This file implements GCC’s Andersen-style inclusion-based solver for the tree-SSA points-to analysis in the `tree-ssa-structalias` subsystem. It builds and mutates the internal constraint graph over varinfo nodes and synthetic dereference/address nodes, computes predecessor and successor relations, performs union-find based variable unification, pointer and location equivalence discovery, indirect-cycle detection, constraint rewriting, and finally propagates points-to bitmaps to produce solved `solution` sets and representative mappings (`var_rep`). It is the executable solving engine behind constraint-based pointer analysis, distinct from the higher-level constraint generation code, and includes dump support for graph visualization.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file for the pta-andersen stem: it contains the solver’s private graph data structures, union-find machinery, graph construction/rewrite steps, propagation algorithm, dumping helpers, and the definition of `pointer_analysis::solve_constraints`, whereas `pta-andersen.h` only exposes that entry point declaration.
